The package initializer marks a Python package and contains no executable domain logic.

AdministrationOfficeGenerator generates office-ID candidates, jurisdiction values, founding years, budgets, operating hours, and email-department names, including type-based policies and cross-office hours variation.

EducationalInstitutionGenerator creates institution-ID candidates, selects institution names and program categories and student/staff counts, and generates levels, accreditations, and types using its configured RNG and dataset.
PoliceOfficerGenerator creates officer-ID candidates and generates badge numbers, hire dates, ranks, and departments using its configured RNG, dataset, or clock basis.
The package initializer marks a Python package and contains no executable domain logic.
AdministrationOffice resolves and caches office fields, composes contact details, and claims unique office IDs; fields include address, staffing, budget, hours, services, departments, and leadership.

EducationalInstitution claims unique institution IDs, resolves and caches school type, level, population, programs, accreditation, facilities, and contact details, and owns founding-year calculation because it conditionally resolves lazy type while preserving getter and RNG order.
PoliceOfficer exposes cached officer identity and personal details with assignment, rank, service history, credentials, and shift.
The initializer exports the administration office, education, and police services as the package API.
AdministrationOfficeService binds its concrete generator and model and declares the entity fields exposed to the registry and DSL.
EducationalInstitutionService binds its concrete generator and model and declares the entity fields exposed to the registry and DSL.
PoliceOfficerService binds its concrete generator and model and declares the entity fields exposed to the registry and DSL.

components.label: models
responsibilities: Expose lazy government-office, educational-institution, and police-officer records with cached identity, founding year, jurisdiction, public-service, facility, and personnel fields.
forbidden_responsibilities: Generate dataset values directly or own service orchestration.

requires.rationale: Public-sector entities delegate computed values to generators.

components.label: generators
responsibilities: Generate office founding years, jurisdictions, budgets, operating hours, and email-department names; officer-ID candidates; institution names, staffing, student counts, programs, and facilities; and officer badge numbers, ranks, assignments, and qualifications.

components.label: services
responsibilities: Bind office, education, and police models to generators, declare DSL fields and datasets, and own the inert package initializer.
forbidden_responsibilities: Implement generator algorithms or bypass entity models.

requires.rationale: Services delegate entity creation to domain generators.

rules.rationale: Each public-sector implementation module has one semantic owner; the package initializer is the source module.
Entities and services may consume generators; generator-to-entity and generator-to-service dependencies remain disallowed.
Only entity, generator, and service types cross family boundaries.
Public-sector ownership flows from generators to entities and services, without reverse generator dependencies.
Value algorithms; must not import entity models/services. Exact reviewed target children; no hidden extra modules.
Lazy domain entities; may call generators for computed values. Exact reviewed target children; no hidden extra modules.
Domain construction workflows using models and generators. Exact reviewed target children; no hidden extra modules.
